tool.name: 3DTrees: Smart Tile
tool.description: Point cloud tiling, subsampling, and merging with instance matching
tool.command:
mkdir -p input_dir output_dir && #for $i, $file in enumerate($input): #set $base_name = $file.element_identifier #set $base_name = $base_name.replace('.dat', '').replace('.laz', '') ln -s '${file.file_name}' 'input_dir/${base_name}.laz' && #end for
python -u /src/run.py --task '$operation.task'
#if $operation.task == 'tile': --input_dir input_dir --output_dir output_dir --tile_length $operation.tile_length --tile_buffer $operation.tile_buffer --grid_offset $operation.grid_offset --workers \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} --threads $operation.threads --resolution_1 $operation.resolution_1 --resolution_2 $operation.resolution_2 #if $operation.skip_dimension_reduction: --skip_dimension_reduction #end if #end if
#if $operation.task == 'merge': --subsampled_10cm_folder input_dir --target_resolution $operation.target_resolution --buffer $operation.buffer --overlap_threshold $operation.overlap_threshold --max_centroid_distance $operation.max_centroid_distance --correspondence_tolerance $operation.correspondence_tolerance --max_volume_for_merge $operation.max_volume_for_merge --workers \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} #if $operation.disable_matching: --disable_matching #end if --output_merged_laz merged_output.laz #end if

param.name: input
param.label: Input Point Clouds
param.help: Collection of LAZ files for tiling or merging (DAT files will be automatically renamed to LAZ)

param.label: Tile Buffer (m)
param.help: Buffer overlap between tiles in meters (default: 5)

param.label: Threads per Writer
param.help: Number of threads per COPC writer (default: 5)

param.label: Preserve All Dimensions
param.help: Keep all point attributes (intensity, RGB, etc.) instead of reducing to XYZ only

param.label: Buffer Distance (m)
param.help: Buffer zone distance for filtering instances (default: 10.0)

param.label: Overlap Threshold
param.help: Overlap ratio threshold for instance matching (default: 0.3 = 30%)

param.label: Max Centroid Distance (m)
param.help: Maximum distance between centroids to merge instances (default: 3.0)

param.label: Correspondence Tolerance (m)
param.help: Maximum distance for point correspondence matching (default: 0.05)

param.label: Max Volume for Merge (m³)
param.help: Maximum convex hull volume for small instance merging (default: 4.0)

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool provides efficient point cloud processing for large-scale 3D tree segmentation:
**Tile Task**: Converts, tiles, and subsamples point clouds for parallel processing
1. Converts LAZ files to COPC (Cloud Optimized Point Cloud) format 2. Builds spatial index for efficient queries 3. Creates overlapping tiles with configurable buffer 4. Subsamples to two resolutions (default: 2cm and 10cm)
**Merge Task**: Remaps predictions and merges segmented tiles back together
1. Remaps predictions from coarse (10cm) to fine (2cm) resolution using KDTree 2. Filters instances in buffer zones to avoid duplicates 3. Performs cross-tile instance matching to unify tree IDs across boundaries 4. Merges small volume fragments to nearby trees 5. Outputs a single unified point cloud
-----
**Tile Parameters**
- **Tile Size**: Size of each tile in meters (default: 100m) - **Tile Buffer**: Overlap between adjacent tiles in meters (default: 5m) - **Grid Offset**: Offset from minimum coordinates for grid alignment (default: 1.0m) - **Threads per Writer**: COPC writer threads (default: 5) - **Resolution 1**: Fine subsampling resolution (default: 0.02m = 2cm) - **Resolution 2**: Coarse subsampling resolution (default: 0.1m = 10cm) - **Preserve All Dimensions**: Keep all point attributes vs. XYZ-only reduction
**Merge Parameters**
- **Target Resolution**: Resolution for remapping predictions (default: 2cm) - **Buffer Distance**: Buffer zone for instance filtering (default: 10m) - **Overlap Threshold**: Minimum overlap ratio for instance matching (default: 0.3) - **Max Centroid Distance**: Maximum distance to merge instance centroids (default: 3m) - **Correspondence Tolerance**: Point matching tolerance (default: 0.05m) - **Max Volume for Merge**: Volume threshold for small fragment merging (default: 4m³)
-----
**Output Structure (Tile Task)**
::
tiles_output.zip/ ├── copc_xyz/ # COPC files (XYZ-only or full dimensions) ├── tiles_100m/ # Tiled point clouds │ ├── c00_r00.copc.laz │ ├── c00_r01.copc.laz │ ├── subsampled_2cm/ # 2cm resolution tiles │ └── subsampled_10cm/ # 10cm resolution tiles ├── tindex_100m.gpkg # Spatial index └── overview_copc_tiles.png
**Workflow**
1. Run **Tile** task on your input point cloud collection (supports .dat and .laz files) 2. Process the 10cm tiles from the output collection with segmentation tool 3. Run **Merge** task on the segmented tiles collection to get final merged output
**Input Format**
- Input files can be `.dat` or `.laz` format - they will be automatically renamed to `.laz` for processing - For tile task: Collection of point cloud files - For merge task: Collection of segmented tile files
